newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower in continued high activity.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower in continued high activity.

text.p: The Czech PX50 closed lower for the third straight session on Thursday despite a late rebound during continuous trading from Komercni Banka and CEZ.
The PX50 index lost 0.3 percent to 556.8 while the major issue dominated RPIX index dropped 0.2 percent to 1,150.6.

Major issues started the day's trading in bearish fashion. At the fixing SPT Telecom, which was then unchanged, was the only one of the top four most heavily capitalised shares not to register a decline.
But by the end of continuous trading SPT had lost 10 crowns to 3,350, Komercni Banka had risen 14 crowns to 2,345 and CEZ gained five crowns to 1,054.
The largest Czech savings bank, Ceska Sporitelna fell six crowns to 323.

The majority of issues in the broader market declined, with regional energy sectors particularly hard hit. The biggest decliner in the sector was Severomoravska Energetika which lost 159 crowns to 3,023.
Computer systems company PVT was the PX50's biggest loser, dropping 201 crowns to 3,830.
Activity overall was high with turnover at 1.6 billion crowns.
